name: Galsang Flower 2
description: Use paper cranes to convey wishes and interpret romance with the language of flowers. Flowers and Cranes, a full series of 6 models - purple lavender, thick complex fragrance, burning glory orchid, foggy snow dandelion, romantic galsang, exquisite peach blossom, each flower has its own personality and meaning. The language of flowers expresses feelings, and the thousand cranes make a gift. The world full of flowers is particularly sunny, warm and gentle.
